primitives.name: Player Value Regression
primitives.verbatim_quote: This research investigates a new method to evaluate the value of current football players, based on establishing the machine learning models to investigate the relations among the various features of players, the salary of players, and the market value of players.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V_p': 'Player value (market or salary proxy)', 'F_i': 'Feature vector of player i', 'S_p': 'Salary of player p'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear dependence of V_p on F_i; stationarity of feature importance across time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When feature space becomes non-linear or when external shocks disrupt salary structures.

layer2.mapping: Kernel-based regression maps F_i to S_p using learned similarity metrics from training data.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error between predicted and actual salaries.

primitives.name: Positional Data Pattern Recognition
primitives.verbatim_quote: Machine learning, a form of artificial intelligence (AI), uses algorithms to detect meaningful patterns and define a structure based on positional data.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{ij}(t)': 'Position of player i at time t in event j', 'D_{ij}': 'Distance traveled by player i during event j', 'T_{ij}': 'Time spent in zone k during event j'}
primitives.assumptions: Positional data is informative and temporally consistent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: In low-data regimes or when positional behavior is highly stochastic.

layer2.mapping: Spatial-temporal trajectories are isomorphic to performance kernels in latent feature space.
layer2.telemetry: Clustering coefficient of positional movement patterns.

primitives.name: Salary Determinant Analysis
primitives.verbatim_quote: The motivation is to explore what are the relations between different features of football players and their salaries - how each feature affects their salaries, or which are the most important features to affect the salary?
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f_k': 'k-th determinant feature', 'w_k': 'weight of feature k in salary model', 's_k': 'standardized score of f_k'}
primitives.assumptions: Each feature contributes independently to salary; weights are static within season.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When inter-feature correlations exceed independence assumption.

layer2.mapping: Weighted sum kernel computes marginal contribution of f_k to S_p.
layer2.telemetry: Shapley values of each feature in salary prediction.
